title: Figures 4-5: Lightcraft vehicle in horizontal guide-wire flight tests
description: Two color photographs. The upper shows a gold, double-cone Lightcraft on a horizontal guide wire, captioned "Figure 4. Lightcraft Flight-Test Vehicle Used in Horizontal Guide-Wire Flight Tests (the top of vehicle is to the right and the laser beam strikes the stretched-out parabolic mirror/propulsion section on the left)". The lower shows the vehicle glowing blue-white during a laser pulse, captioned "Figure 5. Lightcraft Undergoing Horizontal Guide-Wire Flight Test"; both are credited to F. Mead, AFRL/PRSP, Edwards AFB.
